name: Duratek
summary: Established in Tainan, Taiwan, in 1983, Dura Tek, Inc. (Duratek) operates as a specialist in the creation and fabrication of simulation testing apparatus for diverse industrial components. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses critical items such as retaining rings, CVD Shower Plates, Conditioners, Susceptors, and CVD Heaters. Beyond its core offerings, Duratek is actively involved in pioneering research and development focused on advanced manufacturing technologies. Furthermore, the company is a manufacturer of essential components for semiconductor equipment, as well as specialized inspection equipment.
